title: allograph-attacks: testbed, run logs and builder table for allograph attacks on shared agent platforms
description:
Artifact for the paper Your Keys, Their Words: Allograph Attacks on Shared Agent Platforms.

An allograph attack is a line that a co-author adds to a shared agent workflow and that runs with the permissions of whoever starts the workflow. This artifact contains a synthetic shared agent platform and its experiment harness, the raw logs and summary tables of every reported run, a script that regenerates the paper's tables from the logs without an API key, and the table of eight shared agent builders with its sources.
